name: Hyperstack Z-Projection and Temporal Profiling
description:
You are a cell biologist analyzing a 5D confocal movie of a dividing cell. Your goal is to create a simplified 2D time-lapse video of just the chromosomes (Channel 1) and quantify the signal intensity over time.

1. Open the 'Mitosis (26MB, 5D stack)' sample image via File > Open Samples > Mitosis.
2. Perform a Maximum Intensity Z-Projection to collapse the Z-stack into a single 2D image for ALL time frames. The result must be a time-lapse, not a single static image.
3. Split the channels and isolate the Red channel (Channel 1, showing chromosomes).
4. Save this single-channel time-lapse video to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/chromosomes_timelapse.tif.
5. Measure the Mean Gray Value of the entire image for every time frame (creating a plot of intensity vs time).
6. Save these measurements to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/intensity_trace.csv.
